text:
In many cities, people choose between a modern flat in a tower and a house with a garden on the outskirts, and opinions differ on which type of home is better. This essay will consider both views before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of apartments argue that they offer convenience and affordability. Flats are usually closer to work, shops and transport and are cheaper and easier to maintain. A young couple who rent a flat near the metro, for example, can walk to the station and avoid the cost of a second car. Many apartment buildings have shared facilities such as gyms, swimming pools and security staff, and the building manager takes care of repairs. For single people and small households, there is no need for a large space that requires cleaning and costly heating.

On the other hand, supporters of houses argue that they provide space and privacy. Houses give gardens, quiet and room for families but cost more and often lie far from the centre. A family with three children, for example, can use a garden for play, keep pets and have a separate room for each child. Residents have more freedom to decorate, extend and repair their home as they like, and they rarely hear noisy neighbours. A house is also likely to be a better long-term investment in many markets. However, owners must pay for maintenance and often depend on a car to reach work and services.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Overall, I believe that the choice depends on budget and family stage: flats suit young people and those who want city life, whereas houses are better for families who value space.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu căn hộ hiện đại vs nhà có vườn ngoại ô.
Tiện và rẻ: gần việc, cửa hàng, giao thông; ví dụ cặp trẻ thuê gần tàu điện đi bộ đến ga, khỏi xe thứ hai; phòng gym, bể bơi, bảo vệ, quản lý sửa chữa; người độc thân không cần chỗ lớn.
Không gian và riêng tư: vườn, yên tĩnh, chỗ cho gia đình nhưng đắt, xa; ví dụ gia đình ba con dùng vườn chơi, nuôi thú, phòng riêng; tự do sửa, ít ồn; đầu tư dài hạn; nhược: bảo trì, phụ thuộc xe.
Tuỳ ngân sách và giai đoạn gia đình.
